findings.message: waterfront-lawn-reserve (x -10..18, z 39..55) lies 7.75 m outside the 90×70 m site, which is centred on the room cells (building spans x -16..38, z -5..29.5).
guest-hall and dining-room share no wall, so there is no wall to open between them.
single level: no vertical composition, no stair, no upper terrace or roof deck.
every roof is flat with no overhang (23 slabs): no roof-led silhouette or deep eaves for shade.

16 of 22 interior rooms have no window: foyer, gallery, living-room, dining-room, kitchen, pantry, laundry, powder-room, private-hall, suite-1-bath, suite-2-bath, suite-3-bath, suite-4-bath, guest-hall, suite-5-bath, suite-6-bath.
